sources.title: Mature olive tree
sources.description:
Mature olive tree. Overall size 8.978 x 9.361 x 7.000 m; original unbranded model. Overall 9 x 9.4 x 7 m.

Nominal size: 7 m mature height.

glTF binary (GLB) mesh with materials, modeled in meters at real-world scale. Export to other formats from the viewer.

Nominal dimensions for layout, fit checks and visualization; they do not establish a manufacturing tolerance class, load rating or standards certification. Original Innerscene model, released CC0.

license: CC0-1.0, original provider declaration captured 2026-11-12. SHA256 manifest is recorded after baking.
adaptations: Normalize to campaign units, bake multi-angle atlases, deterministic rotated/scaled variants. Stone pine is an artistic umbrella-canopy adaptation of the MIT EZ-Tree pine; date palm is original geometry, not a scanned specimen.
